name: Treasure Island
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Treasure Island was written by Robert Louis Stevenson, first published in 1883.
Young Jim Hawkins sets sail with a treasure map and a crew that includes the unforgettable Long John Silver -- the novel that shaped much of modern pirate fiction.
Discussion prompt: Coming of Age is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
Read at your own pace this week; use today's video as background before or after your reading session.
